name: Abraham’s Travels
summary: Outline of Abraham’s migration from Mesopotamia into Canaan, with sojourns toward Egypt and key patriarchal sites.

stops.note: Departure from Ur of the Chaldeans
Settles by the oaks of Mamre
Covenant and wells in the south

pathHints: Overland arc Ur → Haran → Canaan, with a temporary southward loop toward Egypt.

name: Exodus Outline
summary: High-level wilderness itinerary from the Nile Delta to Sinai and on toward the Plains of Moab. Several stops are geographically debated.
pathHints: Delta → Isthmus/Sinai corridor → South Sinai tradition → Negev/Kadesh → Arabah → Moab.

name: Paul’s First Missionary Journey
summary: Paul and Barnabas travel from Syrian Antioch through Cyprus into southern Asia Minor and return.

stops.note: Sail from the port of Antioch

pathHints: Syria → Cyprus (east to west) → Pamphylia → Pisidia/Lycaonia loop → return via Attalia.

name: Paul’s Second Missionary Journey
summary: Paul revisits Galatian churches, crosses into Macedonia and Achaia, then returns via Ephesus and Caesarea.

stops.note: Departure after the Jerusalem council season
Extended ministry with Aquila and Priscilla

pathHints: Antioch → Asia Minor interior → Troas → Macedonia → Achaia → brief Ephesus → Caesarea/Jerusalem → Antioch.

name: Paul’s Third Missionary Journey
summary: Paul travels through Galatia and Phrygia, spends extended time in Ephesus, revisits Macedonia and Achaia, then returns toward Jerusalem.
pathHints: Focus on long Ephesian residence, then a western loop through Macedonia/Achaia before the coastal return to Judea.

name: Paul’s Journey to Rome
summary: Paul’s custody voyage from Caesarea to Rome: under the lee of Cyprus (north), Myra, Cnidus, under Crete past Salmone along the south coast to Fair Havens, then storm via Cauda (Gavdos) to shipwreck on Malta.

stops.note: Humane stop; friends care for Paul
Transfer to an Alexandrian grain ship for Italy
Acts 27:7 — arrived with difficulty; wind blocked further progress
South of Crete in open water
South into open water toward Cauda
Acts 27:16 — Cauda/Gavdos; secured the boat under its lee
Land in Italy; believers welcome Paul

pathHints: Sidon → north of Cyprus (Karpaz / north coast) → Myra → Cnidus → Cape Salmone → south Crete → Fair Havens → Cauda/Gavdos → Malta → Italy → Rome.

name: Paul Taken to Caesarea
summary: After a plot against Paul in Jerusalem, the Roman commander sends him by night under heavy guard to Antipatris, then on to Governor Felix in Caesarea.

stops.note: Antipatris — overnight stop with the infantry
Delivered to Felix with Lysias’s letter

pathHints: Jerusalem hill country west to Antipatris (Aphek/Sharon), then north along the coastal road to Caesarea Maritima.

name: Peter: Lydda, Joppa and Cornelius in Caesarea
summary: Peter heals Aeneas in Lydda, raises Tabitha in Joppa, then goes to Caesarea at Cornelius’s invitation and later explains the visit in Jerusalem.

stops.note: Tabitha; vision at Simon the tanner’s house

pathHints: Judean hills to the coastal plain (Lydda/Joppa), north to Caesarea Maritima, then back inland to Jerusalem.

name: Festus, Agrippa and the Appeal to Caesar
summary: Festus visits Jerusalem, returns to hear Paul in Caesarea; Paul appeals to Caesar, then defends himself before Agrippa and Bernice still in Caesarea.

stops.note: Festus confers with the chief priests
Hearing; appeal to Caesar; Agrippa’s audience

pathHints: Short round trip for Festus between Caesarea and Jerusalem; Paul’s location remains Caesarea.

name: From Cana to Capernaum
summary: After the wedding at Cana in Galilee, Jesus, his mother, brothers and disciples go down to Capernaum for a few days.

stops.note: Brief stay with the family and disciples

pathHints: Short descent within Galilee from Cana to the lakeside town of Capernaum.

name: Up to Jerusalem for the Feast of Tabernacles
summary: Jesus remains in Galilee while his brothers go up to the feast, then goes up to Jerusalem later and teaches in the temple.

stops.note: Teaches mid-feast in the temple courts

pathHints: Galilee south to Jerusalem for Tabernacles.

name: Lazarus, Bethany and Withdrawal to Ephraim
summary: Jesus goes to Bethany and raises Lazarus, then withdraws with the disciples to the town of Ephraim near the wilderness until Passover draws near.

stops.note: Beyond the Jordan when news arrives

pathHints: East of the Jordan to Bethany near Jerusalem, then north into the Judean hill country toward Ephraim.

name: Raising the Widow’s Son at Nain
summary: Jesus travels from Capernaum’s region to the village of Nain and raises a widow’s only son at the town gate.
pathHints: West/southwest from the Sea of Galilee toward Nain in the hills above the Jezreel Valley.

name: Jeroboam’s Wife to Shiloh
summary: Jeroboam’s wife travels from Tirzah to Shiloh to consult Ahijah about their sick son, then returns to Tirzah.

stops.note: Departs from Jeroboam’s house in Tirzah

pathHints: Short highland round trip: Tirzah → Shiloh → Tirzah.

name: Shishak Attacks Jerusalem
summary: In Rehoboam’s fifth year, Pharaoh Shishak of Egypt comes up and attacks Jerusalem, stripping the Temple and palace treasuries.

stops.note: Attacks Jerusalem; plunders Temple and palace

pathHints: Egypt northward into Judah to Jerusalem (coastal/Via Maris teaching arc).

name: Jeroboam Returns from Egypt
summary: Jeroboam flees Solomon to Shishak in Egypt, then returns when Israel gathers at Shechem to make Rehoboam king.

stops.note: Returns as Israel assembles at Shechem

pathHints: Jerusalem → Egypt → return to Shechem for the kingdom split.

name: Rehoboam at Shechem
summary: Rehoboam goes to Shechem to be made king; after rejecting the people’s petition he flees back to Jerusalem as the northern tribes rebel.
pathHints: Jerusalem → Shechem → panicked return to Jerusalem.

name: Man of God to Bethel
summary: A man of God travels from Judah to Bethel to confront Jeroboam’s altar, then is diverted on the return and dies on the road.
pathHints: Judah highland → Bethel; return by another road.

name: Solomon’s Fleet to Ophir
summary: Solomon builds a fleet at Ezion-geber on the Red Sea; with Tyrian sailors the ships sail to Ophir for gold.

stops.note: Fleet built on the shore of the Red Sea

pathHints: Gulf of Aqaba south/east toward the Ophir trade (locale debated).

name: Queen of Sheba to Jerusalem
summary: The queen of Sheba comes to Jerusalem to test Solomon with hard questions, then returns to her own land.

stops.note: Meets Solomon; royal exchange of gifts

pathHints: Long-distance visit from Sheba (Arabia/Horn traditions) to Jerusalem and back.

name: Elijah to Zarephath
summary: Elijah the Tishbite announces the drought, hides by the Brook Cherith, then goes to Zarephath of Sidon where God sustains a widow’s household.

stops.note: Hides east of the Jordan; fed by ravens
Stays with the widow; oil and meal; raises her son

pathHints: Tishbe in Gilead → Cherith → Phoenician coast at Zarephath (Sidon region).

name: Elijah: Carmel to Jezreel
summary: Elijah confronts the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel; after the rain comes he runs ahead of Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

stops.note: Contest with the prophets of Baal; prayer for rain
Runs before Ahab’s chariot to Jezreel

pathHints: Mount Carmel eastward into the Jezreel Valley.

name: Elijah Flees to Horeb
summary: Threatened by Jezebel, Elijah flees to Beersheba, travels into the wilderness, and reaches Horeb, the mountain of God.

stops.note: Forty days to Horeb; the still small voice

pathHints: Jezreel → Beersheba → south to Horeb/Sinai.

name: Ahab and the Arameans at Aphek
summary: Ben-hadad of Aram besieges Samaria; after Israel’s victory the remaining Arameans flee into Aphek.
pathHints: Samaria campaign culminating at Aphek (site identification debated).

name: Abram Rescues Lot
summary: Eastern kings raid the cities of the plain and carry off Lot; Abram pursues from Mamre to Dan and beyond Damascus, then is blessed by Melchizedek of Salem.

stops.note: Abram camped by the oaks of Mamre
Pursuit to Hobah, north of Damascus
Melchizedek king of Salem meets Abram

pathHints: Mamre north along the hill-country/Jordan rift to Dan, NE to Damascus, return south to Salem.

name: Abraham to Moriah
summary: Three-day journey from Beersheba to the land of Moriah for the binding of Isaac, and return.

stops.note: Abraham returns and lives at Beersheba

pathHints: Beersheba north through the Judean hills to Jerusalem's ridge and back.

name: A Bride for Isaac
summary: Abraham's servant travels to Aram-naharaim (Mesopotamia), finds Rebekah at the city of Nahor, and brings her to Isaac in the Negeb.

stops.note: City of Nahor; Rebekah at the well

pathHints: Long overland route Canaan → Damascus → upper Euphrates (Haran region) and back to the Negeb.

name: Isaac's Wells
summary: Isaac sojourns in Gerar, digs disputed wells in the Valley of Gerar (Esek, Sitnah, Rehoboth), then moves to Beersheba.
pathHints: Short eastward move across the western Negeb.

name: Jacob's Flight to Haran
summary: Jacob flees Esau from Beersheba, dreams of the ladder at Bethel, and arrives at Laban's well in Haran.
pathHints: North through the hill country to Bethel, then the long route via Damascus to Haran.

name: Joseph Sold into Egypt
summary: Jacob sends Joseph from the Valley of Hebron to his brothers at Shechem; he finds them at Dothan, is sold to a caravan from Gilead, and taken to Egypt.

stops.note: Sent from the Valley of Hebron
Thrown into a pit and sold

pathHints: North along the ridge route to Shechem/Dothan, then the caravan road via the coastal plain (Way of the Sea) to Egypt.

name: Jacob's Family Goes to Egypt
summary: The brothers' grain trips from Canaan, Joseph's revelation, and Jacob's descent via Beersheba to settle in Goshen.

stops.note: Settled in the land of Goshen / Rameses

pathHints: Hebron → Beersheba → across northern Sinai coastal road → eastern Delta.

name: Jacob's Burial Procession
summary: Joseph leads a great company from Egypt to bury Jacob; seven days of mourning at the threshing floor of Atad beyond the Jordan; burial at Machpelah.

stops.note: Burial in the cave of Machpelah east of Mamre

pathHints: Route 'beyond the Jordan' implies a Transjordan detour (Atad/Abel-mizraim unlocated); direct line is only schematic.

name: Moses' Flight to Midian and Return
summary: Moses kills an Egyptian, flees to Midian, meets God at Horeb, and returns to Egypt with Aaron.
pathHints: Delta east across Sinai to NW Arabia; Horeb location follows the existing sinai pin (traditional Jebel Musa).

name: From Sinai to Kadesh
summary: Israel breaks camp at Sinai and travels via Taberah, Kibroth-hattaavah and Hazeroth through the wilderness of Paran to Kadesh.

stops.note: Cloud lifts in the second year

pathHints: South Sinai NE through the Hazeroth (Ain Hudra) corridor and the Paran plateau to Kadesh. Intermediate stations unlocated.

name: The Twelve Spies
summary: Twelve spies go from the wilderness of Paran/Kadesh through Zin and the Negeb to Hebron and as far as Rehob near Lebo-hamath; they return with grapes from Eshcol and a bad report.
pathHints: Kadesh north along the ridge route to Hebron and on to the Beqaa (Lebo-hamath), returning the same way.

name: From Kadesh to the Plains of Moab
summary: Edom refuses passage; Aaron dies at Mount Hor; Israel goes around Edom by the Red Sea road, crosses the Zered and Arnon, defeats Sihon and Og, and camps on the plains of Moab.

stops.note: Camp in the Valley of Zered

pathHints: Kadesh → (Mount Hor) → south down the Arabah to the Gulf of Aqaba → north along the desert edge east of Edom/Moab → Heshbon; Bashan sortie to Edrei.

name: Defeat of Sihon and Og
summary: Israel defeats Sihon king of Heshbon at Jahaz and Og king of Bashan at Edrei, taking the land from the Arnon to Mount Hermon.

stops.note: Land as far as the Jabbok/Gilead

pathHints: Arnon north across the Medeba tableland to Heshbon, then north through Gilead into Bashan.

name: Balaam and Balak
summary: Balak summons Balaam from Pethor on the Euphrates; Balaam meets Balak on the Arnon border and blesses Israel from Bamoth-baal, Pisgah and Peor.

stops.note: Balaam's home at Pethor near the River
City of Moab on the Arnon
Israel camped below on the plains of Moab

pathHints: Long route from the middle Euphrates (Pethor) to Moab; final vantage points overlook the camp at Shittim.

name: Moses on Mount Nebo
summary: Moses climbs from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo/Pisgah, views the land from Gilead to the Negeb, dies, and is buried opposite Beth-peor.
pathHints: Short climb; view lines to Gilead, Dan, Naphtali, the western sea, the Negeb and Zoar.

name: Crossing the Jordan
summary: Spies sent from Shittim to Jericho; Israel crosses the Jordan on dry ground as the waters heap up at Adam; twelve stones at Gilgal.
pathHints: East bank (Shittim) west across the Jordan to Gilgal on the eastern edge of Jericho.

name: Jericho and Ai
summary: Jericho falls; defeat and then victory at Ai near Bethel; covenant renewal at Mount Ebal and Mount Gerizim.
pathHints: Jericho west up the Wadi Qelt/ascent to the Ai–Bethel plateau, then north along the ridge to Shechem's mountains.

name: Joshua's Southern Campaign
summary: After the Gibeonite treaty, Joshua marches from Gilgal by night, routs five Amorite kings at Gibeon, pursues via Beth-horon to Azekah and Makkedah, then takes Libnah, Lachish, Gezer's army, Eglon, Hebron and Debir.
pathHints: Up from the Jordan valley to the Gibeon plateau, down the Beth-horon pass into the Shephelah, south through the lowland, east up to Hebron, back to Gilgal. Makkedah, Libnah, Eglon and Debir unlocated.

name: Joshua's Northern Campaign
summary: Jabin of Hazor leads a northern coalition to the waters of Merom; Joshua routs them, pursues to Great Sidon, and burns Hazor.
pathHints: Long march north up the Jordan valley to Upper Galilee (Merom unlocated), pursuit NW to the Phoenician coast.

name: Judah and Simeon's Campaign
summary: Judah and Simeon defeat Adoni-bezek, take Jerusalem, Hebron and Debir, Zephath/Hormah, and the Philistine coast towns.
pathHints: Schematic: hill country south to the Negeb and west to the coast.

name: Ehud and Eglon
summary: Ehud brings tribute to Eglon of Moab at the City of Palms (Jericho), kills him, escapes past the idols near Gilgal to Seirah, rallies Ephraim, and seizes the Jordan fords.

stops.note: Eglon's seat at the City of Palms

pathHints: Jericho oasis → Gilgal → up into Ephraim's hills → back down to the fords.

name: Deborah and Barak
summary: Deborah summons Barak from Kedesh; he musters at Mount Tabor and routs Sisera at the Kishon near Taanach and Megiddo; Sisera flees and is killed by Jael.

stops.note: Deborah's palm between Ramah and Bethel

pathHints: Ephraim hill country → north to Kedesh → Mount Tabor → down into the Jezreel valley along the Kishon.

name: Jephthah against Ammon
summary: Jephthah is recalled from Tob to Mizpah of Gilead, defeats the Ammonites from Aroer to Minnith and Abel-keramim, then fights Ephraim at the Jordan fords.
pathHints: Schematic: Tob, Mizpah of Gilead, Minnith and Abel-keramim are unlocated.

name: Samson's Exploits
summary: Samson of Zorah marries at Timnah, strikes Ashkelon, hides at Etam, fights at Lehi, carries Gaza's gates toward Hebron, is betrayed in the Valley of Sorek, and dies at Gaza.

stops.note: Gates set on the hill facing Hebron

pathHints: Sorek valley ↔ Philistine plain; long haul from Gaza up to Hebron. Etam and Lehi unlocated.

name: Migration of Dan
summary: Danite scouts from Zorah and Eshtaol pass Micah's house in Ephraim, find Laish; 600 warriors camp at Kiriath-jearim (Mahaneh-dan), take Micah's idol and Levite, and capture Laish, renaming it Dan.
pathHints: Shephelah north through the central hills and the Jordan rift to the Huleh basin.

name: The Levite's Concubine and the Benjamite War
summary: A Levite from Ephraim fetches his concubine from Bethlehem, passes Jebus, lodges at Gibeah where she is abused; Israel assembles at Mizpah and fights Benjamin.
pathHints: North–south ridge route Bethlehem → Jebus → Gibeah → Ephraim.

name: Wives for Benjamin
summary: Israel's oath at Mizpah; wives taken from Jabesh-gilead and the daughters of Shiloh (south of Lebonah, east of the Bethel–Shechem highway).
pathHints: Central ridge highway Bethel → Shiloh → Shechem; Jabesh-gilead raid across the Jordan (unlocated).

name: Elkanah and Hannah's Pilgrimage to Shiloh
summary: Elkanah's family goes up yearly from Ramathaim to worship at Shiloh; Hannah prays, then returns to dedicate Samuel to Eli.

stops.note: Yearly sacrifice; Hannah's vow; Samuel left with Eli

pathHints: Short highland round trip north along the Benjamin/Ephraim ridge.

name: The Ark Captured and Carried through Philistia
summary: Israel camps at Ebenezer against the Philistines at Aphek, brings the ark from Shiloh, loses it, and the ark is moved from Ashdod to Gath to Ekron as plagues follow.
pathHints: Highlands west to the Aphek springs, then south through the Philistine plain.

name: The Ark Returns: Ekron to Kiriath-jearim
summary: Cows pull the ark on a new cart from Philistia up the Sorek valley to Beth-shemesh; after judgment there it is taken to Kiriath-jearim for twenty years.

stops.note: Philistine lords send the ark away
Reapers rejoice; men struck for looking in

pathHints: East up the Sorek valley, then NE into the hills of Judah.

name: Samuel's Annual Circuit
summary: Samuel judges Israel year by year on a circuit of Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah, returning home to Ramah.
pathHints: Tight Benjaminite loop with a descent to Gilgal near Jericho.

name: Saul Rescues Jabesh-gilead
summary: Messengers reach Saul at Gibeah; he musters Israel at Bezek, crosses the Jordan by night, routs Nahash, and the kingdom is renewed at Gilgal.

stops.note: Saul hears the news while ploughing

pathHints: North down to the Jordan valley at Bezek, across the river east, then back to Gilgal.

name: Saul and Jonathan at Michmash
summary: Jonathan strikes the garrison at Geba; Philistines camp at Michmash; Saul waits at Gilgal, returns to Geba; Jonathan climbs to the Philistine post and Israel pursues past Beth-aven to Aijalon.

stops.note: Saul's first camp, then Philistine camp

pathHints: Wadi Suweinit pass between Geba and Michmash, then west down to the Aijalon valley.

name: Saul's Campaign against Amalek
summary: Saul strikes Amalek from Havilah to Shur, spares Agag, sets up a monument at Carmel, and is rejected at Gilgal; Samuel goes to Ramah, Saul to Gibeah.

stops.note: City of Amalek / muster at Telaim
Pursuit toward Shur, east of Egypt

pathHints: Negev sweep toward NW Sinai, then back north through Judah to the Jordan valley.

name: Samuel Anoints David at Bethlehem
summary: Samuel travels from Ramah to Bethlehem, anoints David among Jesse's sons, and returns to Ramah.
pathHints: Short ridge-road trip south past Jerusalem.

name: David and Goliath in the Valley of Elah
summary: David brings food from Bethlehem to the battle line at Elah between Socoh and Azekah, kills Goliath, and Israel pursues to Gath and Ekron; Goliath's head is taken to Jerusalem.

stops.note: Pursuit to the gates of Ekron

pathHints: West from the hill country down the Elah valley into the Philistine plain.

name: David in the Judean Wilderness
summary: David saves Keilah, then dodges Saul through the wildernesses of Ziph and Maon, spares him in a cave at En-gedi, meets Abigail at Carmel, and spares him again at the hill of Hachilah.

stops.note: Hill of Hachilah; takes Saul's spear

pathHints: Zig-zag across the Judean desert fringe between the Shephelah and the Dead Sea.

name: David among the Philistines (Ziklag)
summary: David serves Achish of Gath, receives Ziklag, raids toward Shur, marches with the Philistines to Aphek, is sent home, finds Ziklag burned, and pursues the Amalekites across the Besor.
pathHints: Southern Philistine plain and Negev, with a long march north to Aphek and back.

name: Philistines March to Jezreel
summary: The Philistine army musters at Aphek, then moves up the coast to the Jezreel Valley and camps at Shunem facing Saul on Gilboa.
pathHints: North along the Via Maris then east into the Jezreel Valley.

name: David Hears of Saul's Death and Goes to Hebron
summary: An Amalekite brings Saul's crown from Gilboa to Ziklag; David laments, then goes up to Hebron and is anointed king of Judah.
pathHints: Long run south from the Jezreel Valley; then NE from the Negev into the Judean hills.

name: Abner and Joab at the Pool of Gibeon
summary: Abner crowns Ish-bosheth at Mahanaim, marches to Gibeon, loses the battle at the pool, kills Asahel, and retreats through the Arabah; Joab buries Asahel at Bethlehem and marches all night to Hebron.

stops.note: Contest at the pool; Asahel killed
Abner's night march down the Jordan valley

pathHints: Transjordan to Benjamin and back; Joab's arm runs south along the ridge.

name: Abner Defects to David at Hebron
summary: Abner brings Michal (Paltiel weeping behind to Bahurim) and negotiates in Hebron, then is murdered by Joab at the gate.

stops.note: Covenant feast; Abner killed by Joab

pathHints: Jordan crossing, up past Jerusalem, south along the ridge to Hebron.

name: Ish-bosheth's Assassins Go to Hebron
summary: Rechab and Baanah of Beeroth kill Ish-bosheth at noon, travel all night by the Arabah, and bring his head to David, who executes them.
pathHints: Down the Jordan valley, then up through the Judean hills.

name: David Takes Jerusalem
summary: All Israel anoints David at Hebron; he marches on Jebus, captures the stronghold of Zion, and makes it the City of David.
pathHints: North along the ridge road.

name: David Defeats the Philistines in the Valley of Rephaim
summary: Philistines spread out in the Valley of Rephaim; David attacks at Baal-perazim, then circles behind them and strikes from Geba (Gibeon in Chronicles) to Gezer.

stops.note: David goes down to the stronghold

pathHints: SW Jerusalem, then a sweep north-west down to the coastal plain.

name: David Brings the Ark to Jerusalem
summary: David brings the ark from Baale-judah (Kiriath-jearim) on a cart; Uzzah dies at Nacon's threshing floor; the ark stays three months with Obed-edom, then is carried up to the City of David.

stops.note: Nearby: Perez-uzzah and Obed-edom's house; then the tent in the City of David

pathHints: Short ascent east along the Kiriath-jearim ridge to Jerusalem.

name: The Ammonite War and the Siege of Rabbah
summary: Hanun shames David's envoys (who wait at Jericho); Ammon hires Arameans; Joab wins at Rabbah, David defeats Hadadezer at Helam, Joab besieges Rabbah, Uriah dies, and David takes the city.
pathHints: Descent to Jericho, across the Jordan up to the Ammonite plateau; north excursion to Helam.

name: Absalom's Flight to Geshur and Return
summary: Absalom kills Amnon at the shearing at Baal-hazor, flees three years to Talmai in Geshur; Joab uses the wise woman of Tekoa and brings him back to Jerusalem.
pathHints: NE across the Jordan to the Golan; return south to Jerusalem.

name: Absalom's Revolt from Hebron
summary: Absalom goes to Hebron on a vow pretext, is proclaimed king, summons Ahithophel from Giloh, and enters Jerusalem.
pathHints: South along the ridge and back.

name: David Flees Absalom to Mahanaim
summary: David leaves Jerusalem, crosses the Kidron, weeps up the Mount of Olives, is cursed by Shimei at Bahurim, crosses the Jordan at night, and is supplied at Mahanaim.

stops.note: Crosses the brook; ark sent back

pathHints: East over Olivet, down the desert road to the Jordan, then up into Gilead.

name: Battle of the Forest of Ephraim
summary: David's army goes out from Mahanaim; Absalom is caught in an oak and killed; runners race back to David at the gate.

stops.note: Ahimaaz and the Cushite bring news

pathHints: Short Gilead forest sortie.

name: David Returns to Jerusalem
summary: David crosses back at the Jordan, pardons Shimei, parts from Barzillai, gathers Judah at Gilgal, and returns to Jerusalem.
pathHints: Jordan valley crossing, then the Jericho road up to Jerusalem.

name: Sheba's Revolt and Joab's Pursuit
summary: Sheba rallies Israel; Joab kills Amasa at the great stone in Gibeon and pursues Sheba to Abel-beth-maacah, where a wise woman hands over his head.

stops.note: Amasa killed at the great stone
Siege; Sheba's head thrown over the wall

pathHints: Long march north through Israel to the Huleh basin.

name: Saul's Bones Brought Home
summary: After the Gibeonite executions and Rizpah's vigil, David fetches Saul's and Jonathan's bones from Jabesh-gilead and buries them in Zela of Benjamin.

stops.note: Gibeonites demand justice; Rizpah's vigil at Gibeah
Buried at Zela in Benjamin (site unknown)

pathHints: Benjamin to Gilead and back.

name: Three Mighty Men Fetch Water from Bethlehem
summary: While Philistines hold Bethlehem and the Valley of Rephaim, three warriors break through from Adullam to bring David water from the gate well.

stops.note: David pours it out to the LORD

pathHints: Shephelah up to the Bethlehem ridge and back.

name: David's Census
summary: Joab's officers count Israel: across the Jordan at Aroer, to Jazer and Gilead, north to Dan and Sidon and Tyre, then south to Beersheba, returning after nine months; the plague stops at Araunah's threshing floor.
pathHints: Counter-clockwise circuit of the whole land.

name: Solomon Anointed at Gihon
summary: While Adonijah feasts at En-rogel, Solomon rides David's mule down to Gihon, is anointed, and returns to the throne.

stops.note: Adonijah's feast by the Stone of Zoheleth

pathHints: Within Jerusalem: Kidron springs below the City of David.

name: Abiathar Banished to Anathoth
summary: Solomon removes Abiathar from the priesthood and sends him home to Anathoth.
pathHints: Short trip NE over Mount Scopus.

name: Shimei's Fatal Trip to Gath
summary: Confined to Jerusalem, Shimei goes to Achish of Gath after runaway slaves, returns, and is executed.
pathHints: West down to the Philistine plain and back.

name: Solomon's Sacrifice and Dream at Gibeon
summary: Solomon offers a thousand burnt offerings at the great high place of Gibeon, asks for wisdom in a dream, and returns to Jerusalem before the ark.
pathHints: Short NW trip across the Benjamin plateau.

name: Cedar from Lebanon by Sea
summary: Hiram's men and the Gebalites cut cedar and cypress in Lebanon, float them in rafts down the coast to Joppa, and Solomon's men haul them up to Jerusalem.

stops.note: Cedars felled; Solomon's levy works in shifts

pathHints: Mountain to coast, south by sea, then inland up the Aijalon/Beth-horon road.

name: Temple Bronzes Cast in the Jordan Valley
summary: Hiram of Tyre casts the pillars, sea, and vessels in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan, then they are brought up to the temple.

stops.note: Clay moulds between Succoth and Zarethan

pathHints: Coastal Tyre to the Jordan valley, then up to Jerusalem.

name: Solomon's Building Program and Store Cities
summary: Solomon builds the Millo and wall of Jerusalem, Hazor, Megiddo, Gezer, Lower Beth-horon, Baalath, Tamar, and (per Chronicles) conquers Hamath-zobah and builds Tadmor.

stops.note: Tamar in the wilderness of Judah

pathHints: Teaching tour of the gates: Via Maris forts north, then desert outposts.

name: Solomon's Horse and Chariot Trade
summary: Royal merchants buy horses from Kue and chariots from Egypt, re-exporting to the Hittite and Aramean kings.

stops.note: Re-export to Aramean and Hittite kings

pathHints: Egypt–Jerusalem–Cilicia trade axis along the coast.

name: Hadad the Edomite Flees to Egypt
summary: Young Hadad escapes Joab's slaughter in Edom through Midian and Paran to Pharaoh, marries into the court, and returns as Solomon's adversary.
pathHints: Arabah south to Midian, west across Sinai to Egypt.

name: Rezon Seizes Damascus
summary: Rezon flees Hadadezer of Zobah, gathers a band, and takes Damascus, becoming Solomon's adversary.
pathHints: Beqaa south-east across the Anti-Lebanon.

name: Jeroboam Fortifies Shechem and Sets Up the Calves
summary: Jeroboam builds Shechem and Penuel and sets golden calves at Bethel and Dan to stop pilgrimage to Jerusalem.
pathHints: Capital east across the Jordan, then the two frontier shrines.

name: Asa Buys Ben-hadad against Baasha
summary: Baasha fortifies Ramah; Asa sends temple silver to Ben-hadad in Damascus, who strikes Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah, Chinneroth, and Naphtali; Baasha withdraws to Tirzah.

stops.note: Ben-hadad breaks his treaty with Baasha

pathHints: Envoy route Jerusalem→Damascus; Aramean sweep down the Huleh valley.

name: Asa Dismantles Ramah and Builds Geba and Mizpah
summary: All Judah carries away Ramah's stones and timber to build Geba and Mizpah.
pathHints: Short Benjamin border shuffle.

name: Coups at Gibbethon and Tirzah; Omri Builds Samaria
summary: Baasha kills Nadab at Gibbethon; years later the army there proclaims Omri, who besieges Tirzah where Zimri burns the palace; Omri later buys the hill of Samaria.

stops.note: Siege camp; Nadab killed; Omri proclaimed
Zimri burns the palace over himself
Omri buys the hill from Shemer

pathHints: Philistine border up into the Ephraim/Manasseh hills.

name: Elijah Leaves Horeb and Calls Elisha
summary: Commissioned toward the wilderness of Damascus, Elijah finds Elisha ploughing at Abel-meholah and casts his cloak on him.

stops.note: Wilderness of Damascus (commission to anoint Hazael)

pathHints: Long trek north from Sinai to the Jordan valley.

name: Ahab Takes Naboth's Vineyard
summary: Ahab sulks in Samaria; Jezebel's letters have Naboth stoned at Jezreel; Ahab goes down to take the vineyard and meets Elijah.
pathHints: North-east down to the Jezreel valley.

name: Ahab and Jehoshaphat at Ramoth-gilead
summary: Jehoshaphat visits Samaria; Micaiah prophesies defeat; Ahab dies in disguise at Ramoth-gilead and his chariot is washed at the pool of Samaria.

stops.note: Prophets at the threshing floor by the gate
Ahab killed by a random arrow
Ahab buried; dogs lick the blood

pathHints: Ridge north to Samaria, east across the Jordan to the Gilead plateau.

name: Jehoshaphat's Wrecked Fleet at Ezion-geber
summary: Jehoshaphat builds ships at Ezion-geber to go to Ophir for gold (to Tarshish per Chronicles), but they are wrecked.
pathHints: Down the Arabah to the Gulf of Aqaba.

name: Ahaziah's Messengers to Baal-zebub
summary: Injured Ahaziah sends messengers from Samaria to the god of Ekron; Elijah turns them back and later comes down to the king.
pathHints: SW through the Shephelah to Philistia (journey interrupted).

name: Elijah Taken Up: Gilgal to the Jordan
summary: Elijah and Elisha go from Gilgal to Bethel to Jericho and cross the Jordan dry-shod; Elijah is taken up by a whirlwind.

stops.note: Waters parted; Elijah taken up east of the river

pathHints: Highland Bethel then down to the Jordan valley at Jericho.

name: Elisha Returns: Jericho, Bethel, Carmel, Samaria
summary: Elisha re-crosses the Jordan with Elijah's cloak, heals Jericho's spring, is jeered at Bethel, then goes to Mount Carmel and back to Samaria.

stops.note: Strikes the water with the cloak

pathHints: Up from the rift to the hill country, then NW to Carmel and back SE.

name: The Shunammite Rides to Elisha at Carmel
summary: Her son dies; the Shunammite rides from Shunem to Elisha at Mount Carmel, and Elisha returns with her to raise the boy.
pathHints: West across the Jezreel valley and back.

name: Firstfruits from Baal-shalishah
summary: During famine at Gilgal Elisha heals the stew; a man brings firstfruit loaves from Baal-shalishah that feed a hundred.
pathHints: Short trip through the Ephraim hills.

name: Naaman's Journey to Elisha
summary: Naaman travels from Damascus with a letter to the king of Israel, goes to Elisha, washes seven times in the Jordan, and returns with two mule-loads of earth.

stops.note: Commander of the army of Aram
Letter to the king; Elisha's house
Home to worship only the LORD

pathHints: SW over the Golan down to Samaria, east to the Jordan, then home.

name: Arameans Blinded at Dothan
summary: An Aramean force surrounds Elisha at Dothan; struck blind, it is led into Samaria, fed, and sent home.

stops.note: Led blind into the city; feast

pathHints: Dothan valley south to Samaria.

name: Ben-hadad's Siege of Samaria
summary: Ben-hadad besieges Samaria into famine; the Arameans hear phantom armies and flee to the Jordan, leaving the camp to four lepers.
pathHints: Aramean line of retreat east to the Jordan fords.

name: The Shunammite's Seven Years in Philistia
summary: Warned of famine, the Shunammite lives seven years in Philistia, then appeals to the king in Samaria for her land.
pathHints: Down the coast and back.

name: Elisha in Damascus: Hazael
summary: Elisha goes to Damascus; Hazael brings 40 camel-loads of gifts and later smothers Ben-hadad.
pathHints: NE over the Golan.

name: Jehu's Revolt
summary: Anointed at Ramoth-gilead, Jehu drives to Jezreel, kills Joram and Jezebel, then the princes in Samaria, purges Baal worship, but keeps Bethel and Dan.

stops.note: Ahab's sons beheaded; Baal temple destroyed

pathHints: West across the Jordan into the Jezreel valley, then south to Samaria.

name: Hazael Takes the Transjordan
summary: Hazael strikes Israel's territory east of the Jordan: Gilead, Gad, Reuben, Manasseh, from Aroer by the Arnon, Gilead and Bashan.
pathHints: King's Highway south from Damascus.

name: Hazael Takes Gath and Threatens Jerusalem
summary: Hazael captures Gath and turns on Jerusalem; Joash buys him off with temple treasure (Chronicles: Aramean army kills the princes).
pathHints: Down the coastal road then up into Judah.

name: Joash of Israel's Victories from Aphek
summary: Dying Elisha has Joash shoot the arrow of victory; Joash defeats Aram at Aphek and recovers Israelite towns three times.
pathHints: NE to the Golan.

name: Amaziah Conquers Edom
summary: Amaziah (sending home Ephraimite mercenaries) kills 10,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt and takes Sela, renaming it Joktheel.
pathHints: Down the Arabah into Edom.

name: Jehoash Defeats Amaziah at Beth-shemesh
summary: Jehoash of Israel defeats Amaziah at Beth-shemesh, breaks 400 cubits of Jerusalem's wall, and carries hostages and treasure to Samaria.

stops.note: Wall broken from Ephraim Gate to Corner Gate

pathHints: Down the coast road and up the Sorek valley, then the ridge road home.

name: Amaziah Flees to Lachish
summary: Conspirators chase Amaziah from Jerusalem to Lachish, kill him, and bring his body back on horses.
pathHints: SW down into the Shephelah and back.

name: Jeroboam II Restores Israel's Borders
summary: As Jonah of Gath-hepher foretold, Jeroboam II restores Israel from Lebo-hamath to the Sea of the Arabah and recovers Damascus and Hamath.

stops.note: Sea of the Arabah, southern limit

pathHints: Border teaching line from the Orontes to the Dead Sea.

name: Menahem's Coup from Tirzah
summary: Menahem marches from Tirzah to Samaria, kills Shallum, and savagely sacks Tiphsah.

stops.note: Sacked (probably Tappuah near Tirzah, not the Euphrates Tiphsah)

pathHints: Short highland moves.

name: Tiglath-pileser Conquers Galilee and Gilead
summary: Pul extracts tribute from Menahem; later Tiglath-pileser takes Ijon, Abel-beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, Galilee, and all Naphtali, deporting the people to Assyria.
pathHints: Down the Huleh valley from the north, across to Gilead; return east to Assyria.

name: Syro-Ephraimite War against Ahaz
summary: Rezin of Damascus and Pekah of Samaria besiege Jerusalem; Rezin takes Elath; Ahaz bribes Tiglath-pileser, who captures Damascus and deports its people to Kir.
pathHints: N-S axis Damascus→Jerusalem→Elath, then Assyrian counter-strike.

name: Ahaz Goes to Damascus and Copies the Altar
summary: Ahaz meets Tiglath-pileser at Damascus, sends a model of the altar to Uriah, and remodels the temple.
pathHints: North over the Golan and back.

name: Fall of Samaria and Israel's Exile
summary: Hoshea appeals to So of Egypt; Shalmaneser besieges Samaria three years; Israel is deported to Halah, the Habor river of Gozan, and the cities of the Medes.
pathHints: Assyrian campaign west, then deportation route east across the Fertile Crescent.

name: Assyria Resettles Samaria
summary: The king of Assyria brings people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim to Samaria; an exiled priest is sent back to teach at Bethel.
pathHints: Converging arrows from Mesopotamia and Syria into Samaria.

name: Hezekiah Strikes the Philistines to Gaza
summary: Hezekiah defeats the Philistines as far as Gaza and its territory.
pathHints: SW down to the coast.

name: Sennacherib's Invasion of Judah
summary: Sennacherib takes Judah's fortified cities, besieges Lachish, sends the Rabshakeh to Jerusalem, moves to Libnah on news of Tirhakah of Cush, loses 185,000 to the angel, and returns to Nineveh where he is murdered.

stops.note: Rabshakeh at the conduit of the upper pool
Sennacherib killed in Nisroch's temple; sons flee to Ararat

pathHints: Down the Levantine coast to the Shephelah, up to Jerusalem, and home across the Fertile Crescent.

name: Envoys from Merodach-baladan
summary: Babylon's king sends envoys after Hezekiah's illness; Hezekiah shows them everything, and Isaiah foretells the Babylonian exile.
pathHints: Fertile Crescent arc via the Euphrates and Syria.

name: Hezekiah's Tunnel
summary: Hezekiah stops up the upper outlet of the Gihon and directs the water down to the west side of the City of David (Siloam).
pathHints: 533 m S-curve beneath the City of David.

name: Manasseh Taken to Babylon and Restored
summary: Assyrian commanders take Manasseh with hooks to Babylon; he humbles himself and is restored to Jerusalem, where he rebuilds the outer wall to Ophel.
pathHints: Fertile Crescent round trip.

name: Josiah Confronts Neco at Megiddo
summary: Josiah goes out to stop Neco at Megiddo, is shot by archers, and is brought back by chariot to Jerusalem to die.
pathHints: North along the ridge and down to the Jezreel valley.

name: Pharaoh Neco's March to the Euphrates
summary: Neco marches up the coast to aid Assyria at Carchemish, kills Josiah at Megiddo, and on the return deposes Jehoahaz at Riblah.
pathHints: Via Maris north through the Orontes valley to the Euphrates.

name: Jehoahaz Taken to Egypt
summary: Neco imprisons Jehoahaz at Riblah, installs Eliakim (Jehoiakim), and takes Jehoahaz to Egypt where he dies.
pathHints: North to Riblah, then the long coast road to Egypt.

name: Jehoiakim Bound for Babylon
summary: Nebuchadnezzar binds Jehoiakim in chains to take him to Babylon and carries off temple vessels (whether he was actually deported is unclear).

stops.note: Temple vessels placed in Nebuchadnezzar's palace

pathHints: Fertile Crescent route.

name: Jehoiachin's Exile (597 BC)
summary: Nebuchadnezzar besieges Jerusalem, deports Jehoiachin, the court, 10,000 captives, craftsmen and smiths, and installs Zedekiah; decades later Evil-merodach frees Jehoiachin.
pathHints: Via Riblah/Syria and the Euphrates.

name: Fall of Jerusalem and Exile (586 BC)
summary: After an 18-month siege Zedekiah flees by the Arabah road, is caught in the plains of Jericho and blinded at Riblah; Nebuzaradan burns Jerusalem and deports the people to Babylon.

stops.note: Captured in the plains of Jericho
Sons killed; Zedekiah blinded; officials executed

pathHints: East down to Jericho, then north to Riblah and east to Babylon.

name: Gedaliah's Murder and Flight to Egypt
summary: Gedaliah governs from Mizpah until Ishmael kills him; the remnant flees to Egypt for fear of the Chaldeans.
pathHints: Benjamin plateau then the long southern route to Egypt.

name: Cyrus's Decree to Rebuild
summary: In his first year Cyrus of Persia proclaims that exiles may go up to rebuild the house of the LORD in Jerusalem (continued in Ezra 1).
pathHints: Return arc across the Fertile Crescent (detail in Ezra).

name: Simeonites Expand to Gedor and Mount Seir
summary: In Hezekiah's day Simeonites seek pasture east of the valley at Gedor, and 500 go to Mount Seir to destroy the remnant of Amalek.

stops.note: Mount Seir; remnant of Amalek destroyed

pathHints: SE from the Negev into Seir.

name: Transjordan Tribes Deported by Assyria
summary: Pul/Tilgath-pilneser carry Reuben, Gad, and half-Manasseh to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river Gozan.
pathHints: East across the Syrian desert along the Euphrates.

name: Abijah's Victory at Mount Zemaraim
summary: Abijah addresses Israel from Mount Zemaraim, survives an ambush, routs Jeroboam, and takes Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron.
pathHints: North up the ridge into southern Ephraim.

name: Asa Defeats Zerah the Cushite
summary: Zerah's army comes to Mareshah; Asa meets it in the Valley of Zephathah and pursues to Gerar, plundering the surrounding towns.

stops.note: Battle in the Valley of Zephathah

pathHints: SW through the Shephelah into the western Negev.

name: Captives Returned to Jericho
summary: Israel takes 200,000 Judean captives to Samaria; at Oded's rebuke they are clothed, fed, and escorted to Jericho.
pathHints: North to Samaria, then down the Jordan valley.

name: Assyrian Advance on Jerusalem (Isaiah 10)
summary: Poetic itinerary of an invader marching south along the Benjamin ridge until he shakes his fist at Zion from Nob.

stops.note: Mount of the daughter of Zion

pathHints: North-to-south along the watershed: Ai → Michmash pass → Geba → Ramah/Gibeah → Anathoth → Nob → Jerusalem. Migron, Gallim, Laishah, Madmenah and Gebim are unlocated.

name: Sargon's Commander Takes Ashdod
summary: Sargon II's commander captures rebel Ashdod (711 BC); Isaiah walks barefoot as a sign against trusting Egypt and Cush.
pathHints: Assyria south-west to Ashdod; Egypt and Cush shown as the failed allies.

name: Return from Babylon (the 'Second Exodus')
summary: Prophetic summons for the exiles to leave Babylon and return to Zion, fulfilled in the returns under Cyrus (538 BC) and Ezra.
pathHints: Poetic 'highway in the desert' (Isa 40:3); the practical caravan route ran up the Euphrates and south through Syria.

name: Jeremiah's Linen Belt
summary: Jeremiah hides a linen belt at Perath and later finds it ruined — a sign of Judah's pride rotting.
pathHints: Round trip; the short alternative is Wadi Farah 5 km north-east of Anathoth.

name: Uriah's Flight to Egypt
summary: The prophet Uriah of Kiriath-jearim flees Jehoiakim to Egypt, is extradited and executed in Jerusalem.
pathHints: Jerusalem south-west across Sinai to Egypt and back.

name: Deportations to Babylon
summary: The deportations of 605, 597 and 587 BC; Daniel among the first group, Jehoiachin and Ezekiel in 597; Jeremiah writes to the exiles (Jer 29).

stops.note: Babylonian field HQ on the Orontes route

pathHints: Fertile-crescent route: Jerusalem → Damascus → Riblah/Hamath → Carchemish → down the Euphrates to Babylon and Nippur.

name: Zedekiah's Flight and Capture
summary: Zedekiah escapes Jerusalem by night toward the Arabah, is caught in the plains of Jericho, judged at Riblah, blinded and taken to Babylon.

stops.note: Breach in the wall; flight by night
Captured in the plains of Jericho

pathHints: East down to Jericho, then the long northern road to Riblah and Babylon.

name: Jeremiah Freed at Ramah
summary: Nebuzaradan releases Jeremiah from the chained captives at Ramah; he joins Gedaliah at Mizpah.
pathHints: Short hop north along the Benjamin ridge.

name: Ishmael's Massacre at Mizpah
summary: Ishmael murders Gedaliah and 80 pilgrims from Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria, flees with captives, is overtaken at Gibeon and escapes to Ammon.
pathHints: Pilgrims converge on Mizpah from the north; Ishmael's escape runs east across the Jordan to Ammon.

name: Remnant Flees to Egypt
summary: Fearing Babylon, Johanan leads the remnant, with Jeremiah and Baruch, to Egypt against God's word; Judean colonies at Migdol, Tahpanhes, Memphis and Pathros.
pathHints: South past Bethlehem, across northern Sinai to the eastern Delta, then dispersal inside Egypt.

name: Seraiah Takes the Scroll to Babylon
summary: Seraiah travels with Zedekiah to Babylon, reads Jeremiah's oracle and sinks it in the Euphrates.
pathHints: Jerusalem → Syrian corridor → Euphrates → Babylon.

name: Pharaoh Neco to Carchemish
summary: Neco marches north to aid Assyria, kills Josiah at Megiddo (609 BC), deposes Jehoahaz at Riblah, and is crushed by Nebuchadnezzar at Carchemish (605 BC).
pathHints: Via Maris north through the Megiddo pass, the Beqaa and the Orontes to the Euphrates.

name: Ezekiel Carried in Visions to Jerusalem
aliases: glory of the God of Israel
summary: The Spirit lifts Ezekiel from the exiles by the Chebar to the Jerusalem temple (Ezek 8:3; 40:2) and returns him to Chaldea (11:24).

stops.note: Temple abominations; departure of the glory

pathHints: Visionary arc between Nippur and Jerusalem (no physical route).

name: Nebuchadnezzar at the Fork in the Road
summary: The king of Babylon divines at a road junction whether to strike Rabbah of the Ammonites or Jerusalem; the lot falls on Jerusalem.
pathHints: Common route through Syria (fork near Damascus/Riblah), one branch to Rabbah, the other to Jerusalem.

name: News of Jerusalem's Fall Reaches Ezekiel
summary: A fugitive from Jerusalem reaches the exiles in Babylonia: 'The city has fallen.'
pathHints: Fertile-crescent route, about five months' travel.

name: River from the Temple
aliases: waters came out from under the threshold
river that couldn't be passed through
summary: A deepening river flows east from the temple, through the Arabah, healing the Dead Sea; fishermen spread nets from En-gedi to En-eglaim.
pathHints: Flow line east and down from Jerusalem to the Dead Sea.

name: Jonah's Flight and Mission
summary: Jonah of Gath-hepher flees from Joppa toward Tarshish, is swallowed by a great fish, and then preaches in Nineveh.
pathHints: Joppa westward into the Mediterranean (storm), then overland east to Nineveh. Tarshish is the intended, unreached destination.

name: Amos from Tekoa to Bethel
summary: The Judean herdsman Amos prophesies at the royal sanctuary of Bethel and is ordered back to Judah.
pathHints: North along the ridge road from Tekoa past Jerusalem to Bethel and back.

name: Amos's Circle of Oracles
summary: Oracles circle Israel — Damascus, Gaza, Tyre, Edom, Ammon, Moab — then close on Judah and finally Israel.
pathHints: Rhetorical sequence spiralling in; draw as numbered markers rather than a route.

name: Micah's Lament over the Shephelah
summary: Wordplay lament over Shephelah towns, usually linked to Sennacherib's 701 BC approach toward Jerusalem.
pathHints: Cluster in the Shephelah; Beth-le-aphrah, Shaphir, Zaanan, Beth-ezel, Maroth and Achzib are unlocated.

name: The Conqueror's March (Zechariah 9:1–8)
summary: Oracle of judgement sweeping south from Hadrach and Hamath through Damascus, Tyre and Sidon to the Philistine cities, while God guards his house; often compared with Alexander's 332 BC campaign.
pathHints: North-to-south down the Levant coast; Jerusalem protected (Zech 9:8).

name: God Comes from Teman
summary: Theophany march of God from the southern wilderness (Teman, Paran, Cushan, Midian), echoing the Exodus and Sinai traditions.
pathHints: Southern desert arc toward the land; poetic.

name: Mary Visits Elizabeth
summary: After the annunciation in Nazareth, Mary hurries to Zechariah and Elizabeth in a town in the hill country of Judea (tradition: Ein Karem) and returns after three months.

stops.note: Town in the hill country of Judah (Ein Karem tradition)

pathHints: South through the central hill country (or via the Jordan valley) and back.

name: Journey to Bethlehem for the Census
summary: Joseph and the pregnant Mary travel from Nazareth to Bethlehem, the city of David, where Jesus is born.
pathHints: Nazareth → (Jezreel, central hills or Jordan valley) → Jerusalem area → Bethlehem.

name: Presentation in the Temple and Return to Nazareth
summary: On the fortieth day Jesus is presented in the Jerusalem temple; the family then returns to Nazareth.
pathHints: Bethlehem to Jerusalem, then north to Nazareth.

name: Passover Journey at Age Twelve
summary: Jesus stays behind in the temple; his parents search for him and return together to Nazareth.
pathHints: Pilgrim road (often via the Jordan valley) and back.

name: Visit of the Magi
summary: Magi from the east consult Herod in Jerusalem, find the child in Bethlehem, and leave by another route.
pathHints: Arrival from the east (Babylonia/Persia or Arabia proposals) via Jerusalem; return 'by another way'.

name: Flight into Egypt and Return to Nazareth
aliases: Out of Egypt I called my son
summary: Warned in a dream, Joseph takes the family to Egypt; after Herod's death they avoid Archelaus's Judea and settle in Nazareth of Galilee.
pathHints: Coastal road through Gaza into Egypt; return north, bypassing Judea.

name: Jesus Moves from Nazareth to Capernaum
aliases: by the way of the sea
summary: Rejected in the Nazareth synagogue, Jesus makes Capernaum, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali, his base.
pathHints: Nazareth down past Cana/Magdala to the lake shore.

name: Through Samaria to Galilee
summary: Leaving Judea, Jesus passes through Samaria, talks with the woman at Jacob's well near Sychar, and in Cana heals an official's son who lies ill at Capernaum.
pathHints: Ridge road north through Samaria to Galilee.

name: Storm and the Gerasene Demoniac
summary: Jesus stills a storm crossing the lake, delivers the demoniac in the country of the Gerasenes/Gadarenes, and returns across the lake.
pathHints: Lake crossing north-west shore → east shore and back.

name: Feeding the Five Thousand and Walking on the Water
summary: Jesus withdraws by boat to a remote place near Bethsaida, feeds the crowd, walks on the water, and lands at Gennesaret.
pathHints: North shore crossing and night return along the north-west shore.

name: Journey to Tyre, Sidon and the Decapolis
summary: Jesus withdraws to the region of Tyre and Sidon (the Syrophoenician woman), returns via Sidon to the Decapolis, feeds four thousand and sails to Magadan/Dalmanutha.

stops.note: Deaf man healed; four thousand fed

pathHints: Northwest to the Phoenician coast, north to Sidon, then a wide loop east through the Decapolis to the lake.

name: Caesarea Philippi and the Transfiguration
summary: After healing a blind man at Bethsaida, Jesus goes to Caesarea Philippi (Peter's confession), is transfigured on a high mountain, and returns to Capernaum.

stops.note: 'High mountain' — Hermon (Mount Tabor is the Byzantine tradition)

pathHints: North up the Jordan valley to Banias, then back south to the lake.

name: Final Journey to Jerusalem
aliases: set his face to go to Jerusalem
summary: Jesus leaves Galilee, passes along the border of Samaria and through Perea ('beyond the Jordan'), heals at Jericho, meets Zacchaeus and goes up to Jerusalem.

stops.note: Samaritan village refuses; ten lepers healed on the border

pathHints: Galilee → Samaria border → east bank of the Jordan → Jericho ford → ascent to Bethany/Jerusalem.

name: Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem
summary: From Jericho Jesus comes to Bethany and Bethphage, rides a colt over the Mount of Olives and enters Jerusalem to acclaim.
pathHints: Jericho road up through the Judean desert to Bethany, over the Mount of Olives into the city.

name: Arrest, Trials and Crucifixion
summary: From the Last Supper Jesus crosses the Kidron to Gethsemane, is arrested, tried before Caiaphas and Pilate, and crucified at Golgotha.
pathHints: Within and around Jerusalem: upper city → Kidron → Gethsemane → back into the city → Golgotha outside the wall.

name: Road to Emmaus
summary: The risen Jesus walks with two disciples to Emmaus and is recognised in the breaking of bread; they hurry back to Jerusalem.
pathHints: About 60 stadia (11 km) west and back.

name: Resurrection Appearances in Galilee
summary: The disciples go from Jerusalem to the appointed mountain in Galilee and meet the risen Jesus by the Sea of Tiberias.
pathHints: Jerusalem north to Galilee.

name: Ascension from the Mount of Olives
summary: Jesus leads the disciples out as far as Bethany on the Mount of Olives and is taken up; they return to Jerusalem.
pathHints: Short walk east over the Mount of Olives (a Sabbath day's journey) and back.

name: Witnesses to the Ends of the Earth
summary: Programmatic outline of Acts: Jerusalem, all Judea and Samaria, and the ends of the earth (Acts ends in Rome).
pathHints: Expanding rings rather than a single route.

name: Philip the Evangelist
summary: Philip preaches in the city of Samaria, meets the Ethiopian on the Gaza road, reappears at Azotus and preaches along the coast to Caesarea, where he later hosts Paul.

stops.note: Revival in the city of Samaria

pathHints: North to Samaria, south-west to the Gaza road, then up the coast to Caesarea.

name: Ethiopian Official Returns Home
summary: The Ethiopian treasurer, returning from worship in Jerusalem, is baptized on the road toward Gaza and goes on his way rejoicing.
pathHints: South-west to Gaza, then the coastal road through Egypt up the Nile.

name: Saul on the Road to Damascus
summary: Saul sets out from Jerusalem with letters against the believers, is confronted by the risen Jesus near Damascus, and is baptized by Ananias.
pathHints: North-east via the Jordan valley or Galilee and the Golan to Damascus (about 220 km).

name: Saul: Arabia, Damascus, Jerusalem and Tarsus
summary: After his conversion Saul goes to Arabia, returns to Damascus, escapes over the wall, meets the apostles in Jerusalem, and is sent via Caesarea to Tarsus.

stops.note: Hometown; years in Syria and Cilicia

pathHints: Damascus ↔ Nabataean Arabia; Damascus to Jerusalem; coastal departure to Tarsus.

name: Barnabas, Saul and the Antioch Church
summary: Barnabas is sent to Antioch, fetches Saul from Tarsus, and both take famine relief to Jerusalem before returning with John Mark.
pathHints: Levant coastal road and Cilician coast; repeated legs.

name: Peter's Escape and Herod's Death
summary: Herod Agrippa I executes James, imprisons Peter (who is freed by an angel), then goes to Caesarea, where Tyre and Sidon sue for peace and he dies.
pathHints: Jerusalem to the coast at Caesarea; Tyre and Sidon delegations from the north.

name: Journey to the Jerusalem Council
summary: Paul and Barnabas travel from Antioch through Phoenicia and Samaria to the Jerusalem council and return with the apostolic letter.
pathHints: South along the Phoenician coast and through Samaria; return by the same road.

name: Apollos from Alexandria to Corinth
summary: Apollos of Alexandria teaches in Ephesus, is instructed by Priscilla and Aquila, and goes to Achaia (Corinth).
pathHints: Sea route Alexandria → Ephesus → across the Aegean to Corinth.

name: Paul's Planned Journey to Spain
summary: Writing from Corinth, Paul plans to take the collection to Jerusalem, then visit Rome on his way to Spain.
pathHints: Planned, not narrated; draw dashed.

name: Timothy Sent Back to Thessalonica
summary: From Athens Paul sends Timothy back to strengthen the Thessalonians; Timothy rejoins Paul in Corinth with good news.

stops.note: Timothy and Silas arrive from Macedonia

pathHints: Athens north to Thessalonica, then south to Corinth.

name: Epaphroditus between Philippi and Rome
summary: Epaphroditus brings the Philippians' gift to the imprisoned Paul, falls ill, recovers and carries the letter home.
pathHints: Via Egnatia west to the Adriatic, crossing to Brundisium, Via Appia to Rome (assumes a Roman imprisonment).

name: Tychicus and Onesimus to Colossae
summary: Tychicus and the returning slave Onesimus carry Colossians, Ephesians and Philemon from the imprisoned Paul to the Lycus valley.

stops.note: Paul in custody (Ephesus and Caesarea are alternative proposals)

pathHints: Sea route to Ephesus, then the road up the Maeander and Lycus valleys.

name: Circuit of 1 Peter's Provinces
aliases: chosen ones who are living as foreigners
summary: 1 Peter is addressed to believers in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia — probably the courier's route — from 'Babylon' (Rome, 5:13).

stops.note: Landing on the Black Sea coast

pathHints: Clockwise circuit through Anatolian provinces; region centroids only.

name: Letters to the Seven Churches
summary: From Patmos John addresses seven churches of Asia in the order a courier would visit them along the Roman road loop.
pathHints: Patmos to Ephesus by sea, then the circular road north to Pergamum and south-east to Laodicea.
